summary: Full backend + frontend test of the Jacqueline Magawa portfolio. All 7 pytest backend cases passed (health, root, contact valid + honeypot + 3 validation errors). Backend log confirms 'Contact email sent' via Resend. Frontend: all 8 sections present, all data-testids resolve, 8 nav links scroll and toggle .scrolled class, 15 flight-log timeline entries render, 26 gallery tiles + lightbox open/next/prev/close all work, 5 film cards render and film-media-0 swaps poster for a playing <video>, contact form submits and shows 'Thanks — your message has been sent.' Everything in the review request is working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api). In FastAPI this still works because middleware wraps the whole ASGI app on startup, but conventionally middleware should be added before including routers for clarity.
server.py: MongoDB insert failure is logged but silently swallowed (contact still returns success). Fine for UX but ensure the log line is monitored.
server.py: RESEND_API_KEY is committed to /app/backend/.env. Confirm this is a test-mode key (it is, per user note) and rotate before production.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth). Test contact payload uses TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Two test contact messages inserted into MongoDB db.contact_messages (name prefixed TEST_) and two real Resend sends occurred (test mode, delivered to account owner only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — reuse as regression. BASE_URL is the preview URL. Honeypot behavior: POST /api/contact with non-empty 'website' returns 200 but does NOT actually send. Frontend is a static site served by /app/frontend/server.js on port 3000; all interactive elements use kebab-case data-testid. Flight-log entries use classes .tl-item/.tl-date/.tl-tag/.tl-desc (no data-testid). Confirmed working: nav-link-* scroll + .scrolled class toggle, hero-resume-btn, hero-log-btn, gallery-item-0..25, lightbox-close/next/prev-btn, film-card-0..4, film-media-0 click-to-play, contact-form full flow.
